problem: The relation is broken: 'P(X ≤ c) = P(X  c)' has a missing symbol, so the sentence reads as nonsense and students cannot tell which inequality is meant. The whole point of the bullet is that the two probabilities agree.
fix: For a continuous uniform variable, P(X ≤ c) = P(X < c). Do not add a point mass at c.

problem: The caption and figure text say the strip from 0 to 3 minutes is shown with area 0.3, but the plot spec draws only the full rectangle; no shaded 0-to-3 strip appears, so the caption describes something the reader cannot see.
fix: Either add a shaded block from 0 to 3 minutes at height 0.1 to the series, or change the caption to say the strip would have area 3 × 0.1 = 0.3.

problem: It says simulation 'is not developed here', but the Beyond section then develops inverse transform sampling with uniform draws. The two statements pull against each other.
fix: Say 'Simulation builds on uniform random numbers; a short note appears in the Beyond box at the end.'
